title: Landing Page by @mickces: Everyone ships a UI sound kit. 14 sounds, 50 sounds, same tap on every
notes:
Everyone ships a UI sound kit. 14 sounds, 50 sounds, same tap on every site. So I built one that generates them procedurally instead. Never the same kit as anyone else. Trained on thousands of curated sounds, remixed by engines that learned my taste, synthesized live in the browser. More on how it works below.

Designer: @mickces. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
